name: Artwork approval core (any market)
note: Market-independent prepress and approval practice used when no company rulebook is loaded. Written for this prototype.

rules.title: Artwork matches the approved content
rules.text: Ingredients, allergen and dietary statements, nutrition values, claims, net quantity, barcode and other copy on the artwork must match the approved content sheet exactly.

rules.title: No hidden objects
rules.text: Released artwork must not contain text or objects covered by other artwork, because hidden content can reappear at the printer.

rules.title: Folds and safe area
rules.text: Copy must not cross a fold line and must stay inside the dieline's safe area.

rules.title: Dieline marks do not print
rules.text: Dieline guide text and marks must be on a non-printing layer.

rules.title: Approved data is consistent
rules.text: The approved content sheet must be internally consistent and for the same market as the rules applied.
